causes.evidence: Adaptive whole-root lower recomputed independently each key from maximum forelimb reach deficit. Original captured hip bob is superseded by the abrupt correction.

causes.interpretation: Target minimum span47.26cm versus raw source23.3cm is wider even though WORLD_FACTOR=.85. Shorter fore upper limb and longer hind tibia also prevent literal skeletal copying.

causes.cause: Body turns but projected core silhouette remains nearly straight
causes.interpretation: Claiming zero spine motion would be incorrect;25.44deg signed curve excursion exists. The long rigid-looking core and shallow gathered feet are the practical visual weakness.

causes.cause: Height-gated toe pitch turns on over a short phase band
causes.evidence: LH authored pitch=(16+54*drive)*smoothstep(clamp(lift/.055)); lift jumps from17.5mm to53.0mm between consecutive authored source-derived keys.
causes.interpretation: Mathematically continuous rotation still looks fast/hinged; replace height-gating with phase-authored landing/drive/recovery pitch and inspect actual skin sequence.

causes.cause: Supported skin still moves slightly after nominal world translation
causes.interpretation: Rolling/skin deformation is included, so the value does not alone prove sliding. Need framewise skin support and visual plant together; do not claim zero skating.

marker_suspension_proxy.method: All four toe/finger markers exceed their segment minimum height by 2 cm; not actual skinned sole/force contact.

display_timing_limit: Reference display period and overlay are appearance guides, not validated real filming speed. A source/clip speed ratio alone does not establish naturalness.
recommended_authoring_constraints: Fix smooth core curves before local shoulder/limb fitting; no per-key global pelvis drop.
Landmark collection relative to hip/chest while respecting actual model bone lengths; independent neutral offsets should not preserve a wide gathered silhouette.
Use calibrated sagittal toe/carpal phase curves; no source3D ankle quaternion copying.
Revalidate actual skin at support/flight, key boundaries and the repeat boundary, separately from reference visual flow.
limits: Source marker floors/support bands are proxies, not anatomical sole or force contact.
Discrete derivative estimates include linear key interpolation effects; peak identifies a correction artifact rather than measured impact force.
New production assets, native import, and user-facing video acceptance remain pending.
